hero.title: Welcome to the heart of the Bohemian Paradise
hero.subtitle: Peace of pine forests, sandstone rocks at your fingertips and a homey atmosphere.

ubytovani.title: Comfortable Accommodation
ubytovani.subtitle: Choose the accommodation style that suits you best.

junior.title: JUNIOR Cabin
junior.desc: Four-bed wooden cabins right next to the forest. Ideal for nature lovers.

junior_m.title: JUNIOR M Cabin
junior_m.desc: Five-bed cabins with modern interior and a small terrace. Suitable for families with children.

apartman.title: APARTMENT
apartman.desc: Newly renovated rooms with private bathroom and valley view.

studio_male.title: STUDIO small
studio_male.desc: Compact studio for two with a kitchenette and modern equipment.

studio_velke.title: STUDIO large
studio_velke.desc: Spacious studio for four people with a separate bedroom and fully equipped kitchen.

rodina.title: FAMILY Cabin
rodina.desc: Large cabin with multiple bedrooms, ideal for larger families or groups of friends.

javorina.title: JAVORINA Cabin
javorina.desc: Detached cabin with a large garden and privacy, ideal for a peaceful holiday.

premium.title: PREMIUM Cabin
premium.desc: Luxury cabin with premium equipment, hot tub and panoramic view.

ubytovna.title: Hostel
ubytovna.desc: Simple accommodation in rooms with shared bathroom facilities in the main building.

akce.title: PLANNED EVENTS
akce.subtitle: Below you will find a list of all planned events in our recreation area.
akce.no_events: We are currently planning no events.

letni_kino.title: Summer Cinema under the Stars
letni_kino.desc: Come and enjoy screenings of Czech classics under the open sky. Refreshments and blankets provided.

aktualne_u_nas.title: Currently with us
aktualne_u_nas.desc: Fri-Sat: 11:30 to 20:00, Sun: 11:30 to 18:00. Summer is just around the corner! We're taking a break from themed weekends for a while. Our chef regularly updates the menu in the RESTAURANT section.

restaurace.title: Honest Cuisine
restaurace.quote: You will love our burgers and homemade pancakes.

zvihodnene_menu.name: Value menu
zvihodnene_menu.desc: Soup and fried cheese with fries and homemade tartar sauce.

grilovana_klobasa.name: Homemade grilled sausage with bread
grilovana_klobasa.desc: Grilled paprika sausage with coarse-grained mustard, bread and fresh salad.

smazeny_syr.name: Fried cheese with fries and homemade tartar
smazeny_syr.desc: Golden fried cheese with fries and our homemade tartar sauce.

kureci_steak.name: Chicken steak with grilled vegetables
kureci_steak.desc: Chicken breast steak with grilled vegetables

texas_steak.name: Texas steak with fries
texas_steak.desc: Grilled pork steak on a long rib, slightly marbled along the bone, served with golden fries and homemade tartar.

smazeny_kureci_rizek.name: Fried chicken schnitzel
smazeny_kureci_rizek.desc: Golden fried chicken breast schnitzel with parsley potatoes and a lemon wedge.

veprove_sote_kari.name: Pork sauté on curry
veprove_sote_kari.desc: Pork sauté with vegetables on curry, jasmine rice

kanci_gulas.name: Wild boar goulash with bread and onion
kanci_gulas.desc: Wild boar goulash, slowly simmered to full flavor, served with fresh bread.

vegetariansky_salat.name: Vegetarian salad with Feta cheese
vegetariansky_salat.desc: Crispy iceberg lettuce with fresh vegetables, honey-mustard dressing and boiled egg.

veprovy_karbenatek.name: Pork patty with potato
veprovy_karbenatek.desc: Pork patty from bio pig, boiled parsley potato, Coleslaw

hrad_kost.title: Kost Castle
hrad_kost.desc: The Gothic castle was built on a sandstone rock elevation, but atypically hidden in a valley in deep forests.

udoli_plakanek.title: Plakánek Valley
udoli_plakanek.desc: A breathtaking romantic valley surrounded by pine forest and rock massifs.

skalni_obydli_barusky.title: Baruška's Rock Dwelling
skalni_obydli_barusky.desc: Rock dwelling carved before 1850, located near Kost Castle.

drabske_svetnicky.title: Drábské světničky
drabske_svetnicky.desc: Remains of a 13th-century rock castle on sandstone cliffs.

zricenina_zamku_zasadka.title: Zásadka Castle Ruins
zricenina_zamku_zasadka.desc: Remains of a Renaissance chateau built above the confluence of rivers.

prihrazske_skaly.title: Příhrazy Rocks
prihrazske_skaly.desc: Educational trail through rugged terrain with beautiful views.

stare_hrady_u_prihraz.title: Old Castles near Příhrazy
stare_hrady_u_prihraz.desc: Remains of a 13th-century rock castle, now a popular destination.

skalni_hrad_klamorna.title: Klamorna Rock Castle
skalni_hrad_klamorna.desc: Part of a 13th-century defense system in the Příhrazy Rocks.

zricenina_hradu_hynsta.title: Hynšta Castle Ruins
zricenina_hradu_hynsta.desc: Remains of a castle carved into a single rock block.

zricenina_hradu_valecov.title: Valečov Castle Ruins
zricenina_hradu_valecov.desc: Ruins of a medieval rock castle, a landmark of the western part of the region.

statni_hrad_trosky.title: Trosky State Castle
statni_hrad_trosky.desc: Bizarre ruins of a Gothic castle, the symbol of Bohemian Paradise.

zamek_hruba_skala.title: Hrubá Skála Chateau
zamek_hruba_skala.desc: A romantic chateau built on a group of rock towers.

hrad_valdstejn.title: Valdštejn Castle
hrad_valdstejn.desc: The oldest castle in Bohemian Paradise, founded around 1260.

zamek_svijany.title: Svijany Chateau
zamek_svijany.desc: Renaissance fortress rebuilt into a chateau with a local brewery.

zamek_humprecht.title: Humprecht Chateau
zamek_humprecht.desc: Baroque hunting lodge with a unique acoustic tower.

pekarova_brana.title: Pekař's Gate
pekarova_brana.desc: A rock gate in the shape of a Gothic arch carved in 1914.

sluzby.title: Tailor-made Experiences
sluzby.subtitle: We arrange everything from bike rentals to corporate event and wedding organization.

skoly.title: Outdoor Schools
skoly.desc: We provide food 5x a day, drinking regime and a program with instructors.

svatby.title: Outdoor Weddings
svatby.desc: Ceremony on the meadow by the forest, banquet in a rustic hall.

akce.title: Corporate Events
akce.desc: Teambuilding, training or company party with a projector.
